texts.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

The gravity of our own actions pulls us further in, their weight dragging us deeper into the oppressive shadow of a mountainous form.

From atop its graying peaks, an unyielding gaze bores into our minds. We struggle to comprehend the scale of the Insurmountable One before us.

The tallest summit yet beckons to us, challenging us to ascend.

texts.zh:
我们正在召集精英灵能使集会，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中具有力量的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为不越之物。
texts.en:
We are gathering a convocation of elite telepaths, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of significant power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the Insurmountable One.

texts.zh:
随着我们在虚境中升入炫目的高空，无形的山峰触手可及。不越之物亲自测试了我们，和所有的过往来客一样。

遗忘之国高耸入云的陵墓向我们唱着消逝历史的合唱诗。每一层失败和错误的抱负都被打磨成后来者的垫脚石。

然而，这不是一座死气沉沉的坟墓，而一口坩埚。毁灭与复兴的循环将过去的失败重新锻造成未来胜利的基石。毁灭不是结束，而是新的开始。

苍茫之层峦在我们的意识中拔地而起。
texts.en:
As we ascended the dizzying heights of the Shroud, we reached the intangible summit. The Insurmountable One itself tested us, as it has tested all others who came before.

A towering mausoleum of forgotten empires sings to us an echoing chorus of faded history. Each layer of failure and misplaced ambitions has been ground into the foundations of what comes next.

Yet, this is no stagnant grave; it is a crucible. The cycle of ruin and renewal reforges the failures of the past into the bedrock of future triumphs. Destruction is not an end, but a new beginning.

The Pale Mountain rises in our minds.

# 苍茫之层峦 / Pale Mountain

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)
- 来源 Sources：`common/special_projects/04_projects_shroud.txt` · `events/shroud_events.txt` · `common/inline_scripts/shroud/minor_patron_first_contact_end_event.txt` · `common/patrons/patron_types.txt`
- 审阅 Review：2026-10-13（c3b-exploration）· 已审阅 Reviewed

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 次要赞助者“苍茫之层峦”的首次接触事件“虚境中的低语”（shroud.4080），由代码在虚境中自然发现时触发（common/patrons/patron_types.txt:1454），或经“虚境触及者”选项触发（须已接触全部主要赞助者）。  
  First-contact event "Whispers in the Shroud" (shroud.4080) of the minor patron "Pale Mountain", launched by the game on natural discovery in the Shroud (common/patrons/patron_types.txt:1454) or by the Shroud-touched option (all major patrons must be contacted first).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- shroud.4080：单一选项“尝试沟通”按帝国类型启用机械版/蜂巢版/基础版接触项目（events/shroud_events.txt:8786，inline脚本minor_patron_first_contact_start_event）。  
  shroud.4080: the single option enables the robot / hive / base contact project by empire type (events/shroud_events.txt:8786, inline script minor_patron_first_contact_start_event).
- 项目成本5000（社会科技），无时限，完成后触发shroud.4085。  
  The project costs 5000 (society technology), has no time limit and fires shroud.4085 on completion.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- shroud.4085仅一个选项，把接触状态记为completed。  
  shroud.4085 has a single option that sets the first-contact state to completed.
- 三个项目版本互斥，仅由帝国类型决定。  
  The three project versions are mutually exclusive and depend only on empire type.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无其他差异。  
  No other variants.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已对照common/special_projects/04_projects_shroud.txt、events/shroud_events.txt与inline脚本minor_patron_first_contact_start/end_event。  
  Compared %s, %s and the minor_patron_first_contact_start/end_event inline scripts.
- 合并：原有的_HIVE与_ROBOT故事是同一接触项目的帝国类型版本，现并入本故事。  
  Merged: the former _HIVE and _ROBOT stories are the empire-type versions of the same contact project and are now part of this one story.
- 以起始事件为根并添加审阅连接。 项目标题使用游戏内的“未接触前代号”（如“Fathomless Being”），本故事标题使用赞助者名称。  
  The start event is the root, with reviewed bridges. Project titles use the in-game pre-contact code names (e.g. Fathomless Being); the story title uses the patron name.
- 覆盖 Coverage：全部5个文档（含机械/蜂巢版项目）。 / All 5 docs (including robot/hive project versions).
